normalization_rules: Absent operation arrays become empty arrays.
Sort each array by canonical JSON bytes of its normalized operation before assigning zero-based indexes.
Reject duplicate semantic targets, including targets reached by different identifiers after bounded resolution.
Operation paths are /<array>/<decimal index>; account binding rows append /binding.
Resolve existing referenced facts before hashing; references are unique and sorted by (kind,id).
Existing IDs never change. Use command_derived_id with prefix=row_role and the normalized operation path.
Do not include advisory warnings/conflicts in plan hash; apply independently rejects conflicts.
Semantic request is canonical inner request after domain normalization, not transport JSON; create_owner_scope is null for non-create commands.
Binding revision is hash-bearing; a changed binding denies old replay instead of rewriting attribution.
No-op apply preserves the access epoch unless bootstrap creates epoch 1. Changed apply increments it once; compatible replay increments nothing.
